purpose.domain_detail: Italian financial/accounting ERP system (PRAGMA brand) - table maintenance program for general ledger, ABI/CAB bank codes, cost centers, warehouse, CEE balance sheet codes, analytical accounting projects, etc.
purpose.summary: This is a table maintenance program (ga0100) for an Italian accounting/ERP system by PRAGMA. It handles insert, update, delete, and display operations on various master tables including chart of accounts, ABI/CAB bank codes, cost centers, warehouse items, CEE balance sheet codes, and analytical accounting projects. The program supports multiple table types identified by a two-character code and manages field-level directives for each table type.

notable_features: 55 COPY statements for modular file/record definitions
Large OCCURS 5000 TIMES arrays for directives and buffers
CRT STATUS and EVENT STATUS for interactive screen handling
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars out of 148315 bytes (3445 lines total). The program is clearly a mature production system developed over many years (1997-2008) for an Italian accounting package. The AUTHOR field lists PRAGMA [FM],[CP],[PT],[PT] suggesting a software house named PRAGMA. Object computer listed as TI-990-10 (source) and PCI-5H (object) which is unusual but consistent with legacy Micro Focus COBOL targeting PC hardware. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS found; interactive UI is handled via Micro Focus screen/event facilities.
